Name: Ittai, Son of Ribai
Summary: Ittai, son of Ribai of Gibeah of Benjamin, was among David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Ittai the Gittite, who stayed loyal to David in Absalom's revolt.
KeyStory: Ittai son of Ribai of Gibeah stood among David's thirty.
RelatedPeople: King David; Ribai, Father of Ittai
LifeLesson: Two Ittais served David — a Benjamite and a Gittite — and both were loyal.
